description: Defines the implementation of an Ethernet receiver metrics collector class, including methods for collecting and updating metrics, and internal state management.

classes.name: receiver_metrics_collector_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a metrics collector for Ethernet receiver, managing internal statistics and providing metrics collection functionality.

methods.name: receiver_metrics_collector_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collector with enabled/disabled state.

methods.name: disabled
methods.description: Returns true if the collector is disabled.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Gathers current metrics into provided receiver_metrics object.

methods.name: create_time_execution_measurer
methods.description: Creates a new time execution measurer object.

methods.name: update_stats
methods.description: Updates internal statistics counters with elapsed time, bytes, and packet count.

methods.name: reset_stats
methods.description: Resets internal counters to initial state.
